title: ODK Central
summary: An OData ingestion starting point that reads a bounded page of submissions or repeat rows per run.

local: Your project, form, and OData source
referenceNote: Synthetic fixtures only. Not exercised against an ODK Central server. Basic authentication over TLS; session-token credentials are not supported.

cardDescription: Connection code for reading submissions or repeat rows. Your team configures the destination.
